d:
Bihar ki rajdhani patna men lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar taiyariyan tej ho gaee hain. patna men chhath ki bhavyata dekhne ke lie dusre rajyon ke sath-sath videshon se bhi bari sankhya men log pahunchte hain. aise men chhathavratiyon ki suvidha, shraddhaluon ki suraksha aur ghaton ki khubsurti ko behtar banane ke lie patna nagar nigam is bar vyapak star par taiyariyon men juta hai.
